title: Searching and Viewing Recently Accessed Pages in the Zscaler Admin Console

blocks.text: To help you navigate faster, you can search for pages and see recently accessed pages in the Zscaler Admin Console. Search results include Zscaler Admin Console pages (except for items in the Help menu) and do not include:
To search for pages and see recently accessed pages in the Zscaler Admin Console:

blocks.item: On the top banner, locate the Search menu or press Ctrl+K to set your cursor's focus on the menu.
Enter in your search terms. Search provides auto-complete suggestions as you type.
Search keeps a history of your recent searches.

Click any search result to navigate to that page. You can see the pages that you have selected from search results or navigated to most recently by clicking Recently Accessed to the left of the Search menu.
